fullText: Back to jobsSenior Software Engineer - Robinhood Command CenterMenlo Park, CAApplyJoin us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.About the team & role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Robinhood Command Center (RCC) is a newly formed reliability team that serves as the front line for detecting, coordinating, and mitigating production incidents across Robinhood. As part of Robinhood's broader reliability initiative, RCC works closely with product engineering, reliability, observability, infrastructure, and business teams to reduce customer impact and shorten incident duration. As a Senior Engineer, you will be part of the founding RCC team, helping define how Robinhood responds to and learns from incidents at scale. This is a highly visible role focused on incident leadership, operational excellence, and reliability tooling. You will not own product services or core infrastructure, but you will own the processes and tools that enable fast, high-quality incident response. This role is based in our Menlo Park, California office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. What you'll do: Serve as a senior technical leader driving the long-term reliability and observability strategy across Robinhood's infrastructure Partner closely across many different types of engineers to raise the bar for operational excellence and incident response Lead incident mitigation efforts by coordinating service owners, facilitating time-sensitive decisions like rollbacks, traffic shifts, and maintaining a clear source of truth during active incidents Develop and maintain incident management processes and procedures to ensure timely resolution and minimize customer impact Own incident discovery at the company level by defining and maintaining global dashboards and alerts tied to critical user journeys (CUJs), availability, and business-impact metrics Own and evolve incident response tooling and processes, including education, adoption, and measurement of MTTD/MTTR improvements Drive post-incident governance and learning, defining standards for postmortems, SEV reviews, and follow-up tracking to ensure durable reliability improvements Design and implement next-generation failure mitigation strategies that avoid full-region or full-datacenter failovers Define and build frameworks to improve monitoring, alerting, and observability across hundreds of services and systems Define and own the roadmap of bringing observability to critical user journeys for Robinhood's products Deliver key insights and executive-level reporting to enable better business decisions around service quality and reliability Act as a force multiplier through mentoring, technical influence, and contributions to hiring and engineering culture What you bring: 5+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience operating production systems 2+ years focused on reliability engineering, infrastructure, distributed systems, or production operations Hands-on experience serving in incident leadership roles (e.g., IMOC, incident commander, primary oncall) Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, especially during high-severity incidents Deep knowledge of systems reliability, observability frameworks, and fault-tolerant architecture design Experience with multi-region or multi-cluster architectures, capacity planning, and failover strategies Familiarity with modern observability stacks (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) Demonstrated ability to drive measurable improvements in MTTD, MTTR, availability, or customer impact What we offer: Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching top-tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
fullText: Back to jobsTalent Acquisition CoordinatorNew York, NYApplyWho We Are:Galaxy is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, delivering solutions that accelerate progress in finance and artificial intelligence. We believe that blockchain and digital asset innovation will transform how value moves through the world - and we're building the products and services to make that future a reality. Our institutional digital assets platform spans trading, investment banking, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization technology. We also invest in and operate advanced data center infrastructure to power AI and high-performance computing, addressing the growing demand for scalable energy and compute in the U.S. We work at the intersection of finance and technology, helping institutions, startups, and developers navigate a digitally native economy. Led by CEO and Founder Michael Novogratz, our team blends deep crypto expertise with institutional experience and a shared commitment to shaping the future of Web3 and AI. Galaxy is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. To learn more about our businesses and products, visit www.galaxy.com. What We Value: We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be. Seek Excellence. Be Selective To Be Effective. Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled. Disagree Transparently. Encourage Independent Decision-Making. Build Dream Teams. Who You Are:We are looking for a motivated Talent Acquisition Coordinator to support our Chief People Officer and our recruitment efforts. This role will assist with scheduling interviews, managing candidate communication, maintaining hiring databases, and ensuring a smooth hiring process for both candidates and hiring managers. The ideal candidate has strong organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for providing a positive candidate experience. What You'll Do: Manage the CPO's calendar, scheduling meetings, and prioritizing appointments. Handle confidential correspondence, emails, and documents on behalf of the CPO. Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth experience for all parties. Serve as the primary point of contact for candidates, providing updates and answering questions throughout the hiring process. Post job openings on various platforms and manage applications through the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). Assist recruiters with sourcing, screening, and coordinating assessments as needed. Maintain accurate records of candidate interactions, interview feedback, and hiring metrics. Coordinate background checks, reference checks, and pre-employment documentation for new hires. Identify opportunities to enhance recruitment workflows and ensure best practices are followed. In January 2026, Crossmint secured MiCA authorization from Spain's CNMV, becoming one of a select few stablecoin infrastructure providers fully licensed to operate across all 27 EU member states and held to the same regulatory standards as traditional financial institutions. Crossmint also powers the Republic of the Marshall Islands' first digital UBI program, backs MoneyGram's new stablecoin cross-border experience launching in LATAM, and recently partnered with WireX to expand multichain stablecoin payment infrastructure to non-EVM networks like Stellar. The future of finance is stablecoin-native. Crossmint makes it easy to get there. Location Based in New York City or Miami (preferred), but open to remote applicants within the United States. Type of Employment Full-time. Base Salary Range $120,000 - $170,000 Note: Final level and compensation are determined during the interview process based on experience and fit. About the Role You will own the full cycle across Crossmint's fintech vertical, from sourcing and outbound through close and expansion. The edge you bring is the ability to walk into a room with a Head of Product, a compliance officer, or a CTO and earn their trust in the first thirty minutes because you actually understand what they are building and what it will take to make it work. About You Your background is probably not a straight line through sales. Maybe you spent time in consulting, in ops, or on the technical side before moving into GTM. You think in systems, ask better questions than most AEs, and know how to turn a complex deal into a concrete implementation plan. This translates into: 5+ years of experience across GTM, consulting, operations, or technical roles, with meaningful time spent in fintech, payments, or crypto infrastructure. You may have started in consulting, product, engineering, or ops before moving into sales or BD. That non-linear path is a genuine advantage here. Track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals in regulated or technical environments. You know the space Deep understanding of stablecoins, payment rails, wallets, and compliance constraints. Not surface-level familiarity: the kind that lets you push back on a prospect's architecture assumptions and be right. Existing network across fintech founders, operators, or decision-makers is a strong plus. You follow the ecosystem closely and can identify opportunities before they surface in inbound. You think before you pitch You run discovery like a consultant: structured, hypothesis-driven, and focused on understanding the real problem before proposing anything. Comfortable engaging engineers, product leads, and compliance teams in their own language. Able to dive into APIs, integration architecture, and technical tradeoffs to move deals forward, not just escalate to a solutions engineer. You execute with ownership Self-directed and outcome-oriented. You do not need process handed to you. Uses modern tooling and AI to scale research, outbound, follow-ups, and deal execution without sacrificing quality. Trusted cross-functional partner to product, engineering, marketing, and leadership. Why Join Crossmint? Stablecoins are moving from experiment to infrastructure, and the companies building the rails right now will define how money moves for the next decade. Crossmint is MiCA-authorized, backed by top-tier investors, and already powering real payment flows at global scale. You will work directly with founders and senior operators at some of the most ambitious payment companies in the world, helping them design and ship real stablecoin infrastructure. The role rewards depth, technical credibility, and the drive to build pipeline from scratch. Compensation & Benefits Extensive access to leading AI tools and subscriptions, with AI actively encouraged and integrated into daily workflows. We conduct two performance reviews annually. The first addresses performance ratings, bonuses, and promotions. The second encompasses these elements along with salary adjustments reflecting inflation and market conditions. Unlimited, flexible PTO. Parental Leave Program. Flexible work schedule. Company laptop and allowance for any necessary home equipment. Daily stipend for commuting to the office and/or meals. Three company-paid off-sites per year. Health, dental, vision, life, short-term disability (STD), and long-term disability (LTD) insurances. 401(k) Plan. Our Principles Results and delivery: Ship high quality work fast. Build for the long term: Build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. Use AI. Extreme Ownership: Be an effective Directly Responsible Individual (DRI). Be proactive. Be a team player: Be an effective and kind colleague providing credible challenge. Be present and reliable. Talent research indicates that women are often less inclined than men to apply for a role unless they have experience in 100% of the listed skills. However, this list is only a guide. We welcome your application even if you feel you meet around 75% of the requirements. At Crossmint, we believe skills can be learned, and diversity makes us stronger. We work to foster a respectful environment where each person can be their authentic self, free from harassment, racism, and any form of discrimination. We proudly uphold our commitment to diversity and inclusion as an equal opportunity employer, and this policy applies to all employment practices within our organization. Please note that Crossmint never conducts AI-based interviews, and all of our processes include an initial video call with a team member. Crossmint will not request your personal identification documents or any payment at any point during your interview process. Please stay vigilant about potential fraud. If you receive an email that claims to be from Crossmint but ends with any domain other than @crossmint.com, @crossmint.io or @paella.dev, it is not from us. title: Professional Services Consultant (Technical)
fullText: CareersOverviewEngineeringCultureEarly CareersLocationsView All Jobs102View All JobsOverviewEngineeringCultureEarly CareersLocationsView All JobsProfessional Services Consultant (Technical)New York, NY, United StatesPlease note this is for New York, NY, United States. You only need to apply to one location if there are multiple listed for the job.Apply NowRole OverviewApplicationAt Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. THE WORK: At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, and governments, we are improving the global financial system. Ripple Treasury (formerly GTreasury) is the leading innovator of integrated SaaS treasury and risk management solutions for the digital treasurer. We believe data-driven decisions are the heartbeat of a successful enterprise. As a Professional Services Consultant, you are the critical link between our advanced technology and the real-world financial goals of our global clients. Your mission is to deeply understand a client's unique business environment and architect a SQL-backed configuration that transforms their treasury operations into a powerhouse of efficiency. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Discovery & Strategy: Lead deep-dive discovery sessions to uncover client pain points, workflows, and technical requirements. Solution & Data Architecture: Design the "To-Be" state, determining the optimal configuration of Ripple Treasury. You will be responsible for the structural integrity of the data migration and system integration. Advanced SQL Engineering: Design and execute complex SQL scripts for data mapping and custom reporting. While we use AI tools to accelerate script creation, you will own the validation, optimization, and "sanity-checking" of all code. Technical Troubleshooting: Act as the Tier 3 point of contact for implementation issues, diagnosing and resolving data-level discrepancies by tracing logic through complex database schemas. Trusted Advisory: Act as a subject matter expert, guiding clients through treasury best practices and helping them modernize legacy processes using data-driven insights.= Implementation & Configuration: Take a hands-on approach to configuring the platform, ensuring the technical setup - from the UI to the database - aligns perfectly with the strategic vision. Enablement & Training: Facilitate high-impact training sessions that empower users and ensure the client realizes the maximum ROI. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: SQL Logic & Structure: 3+ years of expert-level proficiency in SQL. You must demonstrate "Architectural Thinking" - the ability to understand relational database design and indexing without relying solely on AI-generated syntax. Technical Aptitude: Experience navigating complex software ecosystems and understanding exactly how data flows between treasury systems, banks, and ERPs. AI Augmentation Literacy: Experience using AI tools to increase coding velocity, coupled with the critical eye necessary to debug and refine AI-produced logic. Implementation Background: 3+ years of experience in client-facing solution consulting or software implementations, specifically in ERP or SaaS. Treasury Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of cash management, payments, risk, or hedge accounting. Financial Fluency: Comfortable discussing cash flow, debt, and financial risk with Corporate Treasury and Accounting teams. Consultative Mindset: You don't just take orders; you ask "why," challenge the status quo, and lead clients toward better outcomes. Communication Skills: The ability to translate "tech-speak" (SQL logic and API structures) into "CFO-speak" (ROI and financial risk mitigation). Problem-Solving DNA: A passion for diagnosing issues at the root cause rather than applying "band-aid" fixes to data errors. For positions that will be based in NY, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant's experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions. NY Annual Base Salary Range$112,000 - $140,000 USD WHO WE ARE: Do Your Best Work The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders A learning environment where you can explore the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning. Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team. In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more! Take Control of Your Finances Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support Employee giving match Mobile phone stipend Take Care of Yourself R&R days so you can rest and recharge Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits. Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. fullText: Back to jobsCashiering Support AssociateWestlake, TXApplyJoin us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Cashiering team's mission is to ensure accurate, timely movement of funds across customer brokerage and retirement accounts while delivering a compliant, high-quality client experience. As a Cashiering Specialist, you will own high-volume cashiering workflows - from ACH and wires to checks and transfers - serving as a key operational link between advisors, clients, custodians, and internal partners. This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Clearwater, FL, or Westlake, TX office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do You process a high volume of cashiering transactions (ACH, wires, checks, journals, custodian-to-custodian transfers) accurately, efficiently, and in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements. You monitor and manage daily transaction queues to meet strict deadlines and service-level expectations, researching and resolving discrepancies and inquiries end-to-end. You serve as a primary contact for advisors, their staff, and clients across phone, email, and internal systems, providing clear updates and a smooth, professional experience. You will partner with our clearing firm and internal teams (Operations, Compliance, Technology, Advisor Services) to facilitate transactions, resolve issues, and support cross-functional initiatives. You contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and client experience within cashiering operations. What you bring You have strong knowledge of cashiering procedures, workflows, and regulatory considerations, along with a basic understanding of financial markets and the securities industry. You are exceptionally detail-oriented and organized, able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You communicate clearly and professionally, with excellent data entry, written, and verbal skills, and you're comfortable engaging with clients and advisors over the phone. You bring prior back-office operations experience - preferably in financial services or banking - and are confident handling high-volume transactional workflows using tools like Microsoft Word and Excel. You are a proactive problem-solver with strong analytical, decision-making, and critical thinking skills, who takes ownership, adapts quickly to new systems and technologies, and follows issues through to resolution. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. top-tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. title: Senior Engineering Manager, AI
fullText: Back to jobsSenior Engineering Manager, AI Research and DevelopmentBellevue, WA; Menlo Park, CAApplyJoin us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.About The Team + Role The AI Research & Development team is leading transforming Robinhood into a personalized, AI-native financial platform. We build and scale the applied machine learning systems that power Robinhood's core product surfaces to ensure every user discovers the most relevant tools for their financial journey. Our work is mission-critical; we develop the foundation models that protect our users through advanced risk modeling and drive the company's top priority of hyper-personalization. As the Senior Engineering Manager, AI R&D, you will lead a highly technical organization responsible for the full lifecycle of applied machine learning across a variety of business applications. This is a high-impact applied ML leadership role where you will lead a team responsible for personalization and risk models that directly affect millions of users' financial outcomes. You will oversee the development of advanced modeling frameworks, foundation models, and transformer-based architecture designed to capture complex signals and drive intelligent predictions at scale. The work sits at the intersection of large-scale systems and high-stakes decisioning, where model quality directly translates to user trust and financial impact. This role requires an exceptional leader with a deep background in machine learning and a track record of guiding teams through the development of sophisticated architectures to deliver measurable product impact while maintaining the high standards of performance and security required for a large scale financial platform. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or Bellevue, WA office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. What You'll Do Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing organization of engineers, managers, and applied ML specialists, providing technical guidance, regular feedback, and support for career growth. Guide model development and evaluation, ensuring AI applications are highly performant, secure, and ready to serve millions of customers. Partner cross-functionally with product, design, infrastructure, and other executive leaders to ensure AI platforms meet the complex needs of Robinhood's diverse business lines. Establish clear engineering processes to ensure reliable delivery, code quality, and system scalability across multiple teams. What You Bring Proven engineering leadership experience, with a track record of supporting performance, hiring top talent, managing managers, and driving organizational development. Hands-on experience in Applied Machine Learning, specifically with productionizing applications that use LLMs and advanced models to build real-world products. Deep understanding of ML infrastructure, platforms, and the complexities of deploying AI safely and securely across an enterprise. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S. About the role As a Security Engineer at Ondo Finance, you will help secure our blockchain-based financial products and infrastructure. You'll work with senior engineers to execute security architecture reviews, implement controls for both on-chain and off-chain systems, and support secure delivery as we scale. Working closely with product and engineering teams, you'll help build and maintain secure systems that protect digital assets and sensitive customer and company data. Target Outcomes Improve the security posture of Ondo's on-chain and off-chain systems through practical, high-impact controls Identify, triage, and help remediate vulnerabilities across smart contracts, services, and infrastructure Contribute to security standards and documentation that make secure development the default Help the team respond effectively to security incidents through solid detection, runbooks, and follow-through Responsibilities Support security architecture reviews for blockchain products, focusing on smart contract security, key management, and Web3 integrations Implement and iterate on security controls for both on-chain and off-chain systems Perform security assessments of smart contracts and blockchain infrastructure (manual review and tooling-assisted) Participate in on-call rotation and incident response support as needed Partner with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the development lifecycle (threat modeling, secure design reviews, pre-release checks) Support third-party security assessments and coordination with external auditors Help maintain security documentation, runbooks, and training materials Requirements 3+ years of experience in security engineering or adjacent infrastructure/software engineering with a strong security focus Working understanding of cryptography and blockchain security principles Experience assessing and securing smart contracts and/or DeFi protocols (professional experience or meaningful open-source contributions) Familiarity with security fundamentals for distributed systems (authn/authz, secrets management, network segmentation, logging/monitoring) Exposure to incident response and security monitoring workflows Ability to read code to identify and assess security risks; ability to write code in common scripting languages to support security solutions and automation Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders Nice to haves Experience with Solidity, Rust-Solana, Move, or Go Background in traditional finance or FinTech security Experience with formal verification and automated security testing Knowledge of cross-chain bridges and interoperability protocols Experience improving CI/CD security for smart contract deployment Experience with multi-signature systems and custody solutions What we offer - Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) - we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation - Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO) - Small remote-first team across many countries - you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices - A+ colleagues - our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom - top-tier investors - we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures Ready to apply? Have the ability to interpret message schemas, structured data fields, and validation rules, and to work with engineering on API design considerations including authentication, permissions, rate limits, and resiliency. Are comfortable working with data using SQL, Excel, or scripting tools to analyze settlement activity, reconciliation breaks, and operational metrics. fullText: Back to jobsDirector, AI & ChatbotKuala Lumpur, MalaysiaApply Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more. About the Team The Bot Intelligence is a core function within Global Business Services (GBS), responsible for building scalable, high-performance operational systems that power OKX's global customer experience. They sit at the intersection of Customer Operations, AI & Data Systems (LLMs, NLP, GenAI platforms), Product & Engineering, and Knowledge & Content Systems. This function is evolving from traditional chatbot operations into a data- and AI-driven intelligence layer, enabling automation, scalability, and consistent customer experience across 40+ markets. About The Opportunity As Director, AI & Bot Intelligence, you will own and scale OKX's conversational AI and bot intelligence capability globally. You will lead the transformation of the function from performance management and annotation into a strategic, AI-driven capability that materially improves automation, efficiency, and customer experience at scale. You will operate as a technical leader, a strategic partner to AI, Product, and Engineering teams, and a builder of high-performing, AI-native teams. What You'll Be Doing Own end-to-end performance of OKX's global chatbot ecosystem, driving improvements in resolution rate, containment/deflection, fallback reduction, and response quality; define and implement global performance standards, and lead the shift from post-deployment stabilization to continuous optimization at scale. Serve as the most technically credible AI voice within GBS - applying deep expertise in NLP, intent classification, entity recognition, RAG, prompt engineering, and model evaluation to diagnose issues across model behavior, annotation quality, content gaps, and flow design, and to partner with AI teams on model performance, training data strategy, and new capability evaluation. Evolve the bot function into a data-driven intelligence system, including annotation and training data pipelines, intent architecture and taxonomy, knowledge and retrieval optimization, performance feedback loops, and integration with backend systems and knowledge management platforms. Drive measurable gains in automation coverage, cost-to-serve, and operational efficiency; establish performance frameworks that connect bot metrics to business outcomes and surface clear drivers of improvement. Act as primary GBS representative for bot intelligence across AI/Data Science, Product & Engineering, and Knowledge Management, translating operational insights into technical requirements and model behavior into actionable improvements, and influencing roadmap decisions through data-driven, technically grounded input. Lead and develop Bot Operations Specialists and Bot Annotators, building capabilities in AI/LLM literacy, annotation quality, and performance analytics, while driving a culture of technical curiosity, data-driven decision making, and high accountability. What We Look For In You 8+ years of experience spanning conversational AI/NLP/LLM systems and operations in fintech, crypto, trading, or high-scale digital platforms, with 4+ years in senior leadership roles managing technical or AI-adjacent teams. Strong hands-on expertise in NLP and LLM systems, prompt engineering, RAG, training data and annotation frameworks, and model evaluation and performance diagnostics, plus working knowledge of backend systems (APIs, integrations, data flows). Proven track record of improving bot or AI-driven customer experience at scale, delivering measurable gains in automation and efficiency, and building high-performing teams. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence technical and product stakeholders in global, fast-paced environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent English communication skills at both technical and executive levels. Nice to Haves Experience in crypto, fintech, or trading platforms, particularly in high-growth, high-complexity environments. Hands-on experience establishing annotation standards (intent taxonomy, entity labeling, outcome classification) and partnering with Knowledge teams to optimize content for LLM retrieval. Experience piloting emerging LLM and conversational AI capabilities in production operational contexts. Fluency in Mandarin is preferred to better support internal stakeholders and partners across APAC markets. fullText: Senior Application Security EngineerNew York, New YorkApplyAbout the Company Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all - bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact. The Department: Application Security Gemini operates at the intersection of financial services and emerging technology where the consequences of security failure are measured in customer trust and regulatory standing. The Application Security (AppSec) team exists to make sure security is never an afterthought. We are on a mission to secure products at the time of thought and the time of build: at the product requirements doc, the technical architectural decision, at the line of code. We believe that security input is most valuable before the work is done and after-the-fact is too late and too expensive. The Role: Senior Application Security Engineer As a Senior Application Security Engineer on the Application Security team, you will be a trusted partner to engineering, product, and business teams across Gemini. You will help guide teams to design and build secure products while building systems and culture that embed security judgment into every team. Gemini is AI-first and AppSec builds the tools to make this vision secure. This role is required to be in person twice a week at our New York City, NY office. Responsibilities: Lead secure design reviews, threat modeling, code review, and penetration testing for high-risk products such as crypto custody, trading systems, and payments Build and ship code: design and build AppSec tooling including AI agents for secure design and code review, AI-enhanced SAST/DAST pipelines, and automation that eliminates repeatable security toil Partner with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities and drive long-term improvements in secure coding practices Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in application security or similar roles Ability to perform design reviews, threat modeling, secure code reviews, or penetration testing with an attacker mindset Experience building or meaningfully contributing to security tooling and automation Strong background in application security best practices and familiarity with common vulnerabilities (e.g. SSRF, race conditions, privilege escalations, etc.) Some background in development or scripting experience (Python, Scala, C++, or JavaScript) with the ability to read and write code Strong communication skills to influence without authority and the ability to collaborate on a cross-functional team with competing priorities Preferred Qualifications: Experience building AI application security tooling using agents or skills Experience with supply chain security, common frameworks (SLSA, OWASP SPVS) and other CI/CD security controls Familiarity with highly regulated environments (financial services, fintech, crypto, or equivalent) and ability to understand business objectives, business context, and security risk Experience with preventing application security vulnerabilities at scale through secure design patterns, automated tooling, or frameworks Experience with microservice architectures and cloud-native environments It Pays to Work Here The compensation & benefits package for this role includes: Competitive starting pay A discretionary annual bonus is between $140,000 - $200,000 in the State of New York, the State of California and the State of Washington. title: Design Engineer
fullText: Back to jobsDesign EngineerRemote, CanadaApply At Shakepay, we're on a mission to usher in the Bitcoin golden age. We're rethinking financial services to give every Canadian their fair shake.Our culture is built around doing work that matters, winning as a team, and celebrating success. If you're the kind of person who values growth, shipping fast, and sharing your ideas openly with a group of like-minded people, come and build with us! About Shakepay Since 2015, we've been building the Shakepay app to make buying and earning bitcoin fast, easy, and secure. In 2022, we launched the Shakepay Card, allowing shakers to earn bitcoin rewards when they shop. Today, more than one million Canadians use Shakepay to grow their bitcoin savings and take control of their financial future. We're regulated across all Canadian provinces and territories, and backed by renowned venture capitalists with $44M in funding. We have a passionate, loyal, and growing community, and we're looking for people who want to help us build something truly special. Design Engineer As a Design Engineer, you are the ultimate bridge between design, product, and engineering. You don't just design features; you build them. We are leaning heavily into a design-led product development approach, and in this role, your primary focus will be taking complex problems, designing intuitive solutions, and writing the code to prototype or ship them to our customers rapidly. If you are a builder who loves living at the intersection of pixel-perfect design and production-ready code, this is for you. What you'll be doing Own problems end-to-end: Take full ownership of product features from understanding the problem, to designing the experience, to writing the front-end code and shipping it to users. Prototype in code: Replace static mockups with functional prototypes to validate ideas quickly and de-risk decisions with real customer feedback. Drive design-led development: Work in a fixed-time, variable-scope environment. Focus on outcomes over outputs, partnering closely with backend and core engineering to deliver meaningful impact. Ship fast without sacrificing quality: Balance speed and craft. Deliver polished, production-ready experiences on tight timelines, with strong attention to detail in both design and code. Elevate the UI architecture: Evolve our design system and component libraries so design and code stay perfectly in sync across mobile and web platforms. Act as a force multiplier: Raise the bar for the entire design team by helping designers ship in code and integrate AI tools into their workflows - improving speed, autonomy, and technical depth across the organization. Who we're looking for Proven hybrid experience: You've shipped real products where you owned both the design and code implementation (e.g. React Native, Node, Typescript, Vue.js etc.). A builder's portfolio: You can point to live products - not just mockups - where you designed and built the experience. You likely use AI tools to prototype, iterate, and accelerate your workflow. Strong product taste: You have a sharp eye for quality and know what makes an experience feel intuitive, fast, and delightful. Deep technical understanding: You understand the constraints and possibilities of modern front-end development, and design accordingly - building solutions that are performant, scalable, and maintainable. A builder mindset: You don't wait for specs. You define problems, make decisions, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight. Excellent communication skills: You can articulate design decisions and technical trade-offs clearly across design and engineering. Passion for Bitcoin, financial empowerment, and the future of money. Why join us? Help shape the future of money: Be part of a team that's transforming financial services in Canada, one sat at a time. Impact millions: As cryptocurrency continues to gain traction, our potential for growth is massive. You can help us bring Shakepay and Bitcoin to all Canadians. Grow your career: We're growing, and so can you! We have programs in place to encourage continuous learning, growth, and development. Ideas, not titles: We want the best ideas to make their way through, no matter where they come from. Perks and benefits 🤝 Be an owner - Every employee has stock options as part of their total compensation 🥅 Reach your goals - Yearly salary assessments 🦷 Health & wellness : Access to comprehensive health and dental coverage, including health and wellness spending accounts. 🌎 Remote-friendly: Work from anywhere in Canada, with optional access to our office spaces in Montreal and Toronto. 🆙 Level Up: A $2,000 annual budget for courses, certifications, and training to support your career growth. 🌴 Time off: 20 days of vacation per year. And if you use all your vacation, we give you a $1,000 bonus. 🐣 Parental leave: Enjoy a parental leave top up to 100% of your salary for 18 weeks. 🙌 Have fun together: quarterly team-specific or company-wide offsite to connect with each other The base salary range for this position is $150,000+ CAD. Base pay may vary based on factors such as years of experience, skills and qualifications. Additionally, employees are eligible for equity, pay increases based on performance, benefits including health and dental care, and paid time off. We understand that potential can be just as valuable as experience. If you're eager to learn, grow, and contribute to the mission but worry that you may not have the "right" experience, we still want you to apply. We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background and life experience. We're firm believers that a little bit of slope makes up for a lot of y-intercept. Fluency in English is required due to the percentage of English-speaking customers and the nature of our platform, which is available to all Canadians. We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain parts of our hiring process. This can include tools that assist with scheduling, application review, candidate communications, and generating interview notes, guides, or summaries so our team can stay focused on the conversation. title: Design Director, Visual Systems
fullText: Back to jobsDesign Director, Visual SystemsSan Jose, California, United StatesApply Who We Are OKX is one of the world's leading crypto platforms - a regulated exchange, a self-custody wallet, and a growing ecosystem of decentralized applications used by millions globally. We move fast, ship constantly, and operate across trading, DeFi, payments, and social products - each with distinct users and design challenges. Our design organization is in the middle of a meaningful transformation: raising craft standards, building tighter brand-to-product coherence, and embedding AI into how we work. We're backed by our core principles - We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done - and we take those seriously in how we hire, build, and ship. About the Opportunity We're looking for a Design Director of Visual Systems to own the visual language, creative quality, and brand coherence of OKX's product experiences. The core mandate: build and scale the visual infrastructure that ensures brand intent translates into what users actually see in the product. OKX has strong Brand and Product Design teams - and the opportunity now is to bring them closer together through shared visual infrastructure. We need someone who can build that connective layer: shared visual systems, shared language, and a creative infrastructure that ensures brand strategy is embedded into every screen from the start. You'll lead and grow a global team of visual designers, set art direction across product and campaign work, and define the visual systems and frameworks that let us scale quality without scaling headcount linearly. Why This Role Is Interesting You'd be joining at a moment where OKX is investing heavily in design infrastructure as a competitive advantage. You won't just be making things look good - you'll be building the foundational visual layer that determines how products are constructed. The products span trading, DeFi, wallet, payments, and social - each with millions of users and distinct design challenges. The brand is ambitious and growing. The team is global. And the company is actively building AI into its design workflows, which means you'll have room to experiment with how visual output is produced and systematized, not just what it looks like. This isn't a maintenance role. It's a build role - you're creating the visual systems layer from the ground up. What You'll Be Doing Build the visual systems layer. Define and maintain the visual language that governs how OKX looks and feels - spanning illustration, motion, iconography, color, typography, and layout. Architect these as scalable, programmable systems that integrate with the broader Design System and Content System, not as one-off assets. Bridge brand and product. Build a working model between Visual Systems and the Brand Design organization - one based on co-creation, not handoffs. Translate brand direction from go-to-market campaigns into in-app experiences, so users encounter one coherent visual identity from landing page to core product flow. Set creative direction. Bring a strong, opinionated point of view on art direction, design rationale, and visual storytelling. Own the creative bar for product and campaign work. Ensure the visual systems you build encode this point of view so quality scales beyond your direct involvement. Lead and grow the team. Mentor and develop visual designers across experience levels. Raise the standard from tactical asset production to systems-oriented, concept-driven design. Hire well. Create a culture of craft, critique, and creative ambition. Build reusable creative infrastructure. Design scalable templates, token-driven visual frameworks, and component-level creative guidance that the team can deploy across evergreen campaigns, product launches, and growth experiments - reducing rework and increasing speed without sacrificing quality. What We Look For In You 8+ years of experience in visual design, with a portfolio that demonstrates concept-driven work, art direction, and brand-led product design - not just execution. Experience building or contributing to visual systems, design languages, or brand-in-product frameworks is strongly valued. Proven track record leading and developing a design team - hiring, mentoring, and raising the creative bar across the group. Deep expertise in art direction with the ability to define and maintain a cohesive visual system across illustration, motion, iconography, and layout - and the systems thinking to make it scalable. A background that blends agency and in-house product experience - you're equally comfortable in campaign mode and product mode. Strong understanding of how brand strategy translates into product experiences, and the ability to architect visual systems that are both brand-compliant and technically scalable. A systems thinker and strategic operator - you think in terms of tiered prioritization, reusable frameworks, tokens, and tradeoffs. You solve problems through infrastructure, not just more people. AI-native in your design practice - you actively use AI tools in your creative workflow for ideation, visual production, asset generation, or systematic design work. This isn't about curiosity; it's about having hands-on experience integrating AI into how you and your team produce work at scale. What Sets You Apart Experience in crypto, fintech, or other fast-moving, highly regulated industries where trust, clarity, and speed all matter. Experience leading design across globally distributed teams, particularly in APAC. Fluency in Mandarin - valuable for working with cross-functional partners and stakeholders in the region. title: Deputy General Counsel, Strategic Partnerships
fullText: Back to jobsDeputy General Counsel, Strategic PartnershipsNew York, United StatesApply Who We Are At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. About the Legal Team The Global Legal team is a leading function that provides strategic legal counsel to OKX and its affiliated entities across every coverage area and jurisdiction. We are architects of the legal frameworks that enable OKX to scale responsibly, advising on the regulatory, contractual, and policy dimensions of everything we do. Our attorneys are embedded across the globe, handling matters across hundreds of markets, from established financial centers to emerging crypto-forward jurisdictions. OKX's institutional business is one of the fastest-growing segments of our global platform, serving hundreds of the world's most sophisticated trading firms, funds, and financial institutions. As crypto enters its next phase of institutional adoption, we're looking for a senior legal leader to architect the legal frameworks that will underpin this growth - across custody, trading, prime services, and strategic partnerships - in a regulatory environment that is still being defined. About the Opportunity: In this role, you will report to OKX's Global Head of Commercial and Marketing Legal, lead a small but mighty global team and own legal coverage for a deal pipeline that spans hundreds of strategic and institutional counterparties and billions in annual notional flow. You will work directly with OKX's executive leadership and have visibility into the company's most strategically significant initiatives. This is a defining leadership role within OKX's Global Legal function. As Deputy General Counsel, Strategic Institutional Partnerships, you will serve as the senior legal architect for one of OKX's most strategically important business lines: our institutional trading, custody, and partnership ecosystem. You will be the primary legal authority on all matters touching institutional clients and strategic counterparties, owning the legal relationship from first engagement to executed agreements and ongoing compliance. You will lead a team of talented attorneys and legal operations professionals, serve as a trusted board-level counsellor to senior executives, and partner with product and business teams to bring complex, multi-jurisdictional offerings to market with speed and precision. This is not a reactive, gatekeeping role. We are looking for a commercially-minded lawyer who leans in, shapes strategy, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-moving environment where legal frameworks are still taking shape alongside the industry itself. What You'll Be Doing: Serve as the lead legal authority on all strategic institutional partnerships and trading arrangements, including custody, exchange integrations, prime brokerage, staking, co-investments, and alliances. Advise on complex cross-border transactions, crypto product structuring, and multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance, including token classification and securities law. Architect the contracting infrastructure, templates, playbooks, and fallback positions, that enables high-volume, high-consistency institutional deal execution. Own end-to-end legal due diligence on institutional counterparties, and build senior-level relationships with clients, counterparties, and external counsel across the deal lifecycle. Translate complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, commercially actionable guidance for product, engineering, and executive teams. Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing, multi-disciplinary legal team while fostering a rigorous, pragmatic, and collaborative culture. What We Look For In You: Must Haves Active membership with a U.S. state bar, or equivalent. 10+ years of post-qualification legal experience, with a demonstrable track record at a top-tier law firm and/or in an in-house role at a leading financial institution. Substantial hands-on expertise in cryptocurrency and digital assets law, including token classification, custody structures, exchange regulation, and DeFi. Meaningful, deal-level exposure to strategic institutional trading, prime brokerage, custody, or structured products. Demonstrated experience building, managing, and developing legal teams in a high-velocity, growth-oriented environment. Exceptional negotiation, written, and oral communication skills, with the judgment and gravitas to advise at the C-suite level. Strongly Preferred Working knowledge of multiple regulatory regimes most relevant to our business (MiCA, SEC, CFTC, FinCEN, FCA, VARA, FSRA, or equivalent). Experience closing cross-border institutional agreements under time pressure. Prior experience designing scalable legal processes, playbooks, and fallback frameworks. title: Staff Product Designer
fullText: Back to jobsStaff Product DesignerRemote, CanadaApply At Shakepay, we're on a mission to usher in the Bitcoin golden age. We're rethinking financial services to give every Canadian their fair shake.Our culture is built around doing work that matters, winning as a team, and celebrating success. If you're the kind of person who values growth, shipping fast, and sharing your ideas openly with a group of like-minded people, come and build with us! About Shakepay Since 2015, we've been building the Shakepay app to make buying and earning bitcoin fast, easy, and secure. In 2022, we launched the Shakepay Card, allowing shakers to earn bitcoin rewards when they shop. Today, more than one million Canadians use Shakepay to grow their bitcoin savings and take control of their financial future. We're regulated across all Canadian provinces and territories, and backed by renowned venture capitalists with a funding of $44M. We have a passionate, loyal, and growing community, and we're looking for people who want to help us build something truly special. Staff Product Designer As a Staff Product Designer, you'll drive design direction across key areas of the Shakepay product, tackling our most complex and ambiguous challenges. You'll operate as a force multiplier - raising the bar for craft, influencing product strategy, and helping teams ship better, faster. You won't just design experiences - you'll shape what we build and how we build it. You'll work across teams, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure we deliver cohesive, high-quality experiences at scale. What you'll be doing Lead high-impact, ambiguous initiatives: Take ownership of the most complex product challenges, turning unclear problem spaces into clear, actionable solutions from concept to execution. Drive product and design direction: Partner with Product and Engineering to shape roadmap decisions, influence strategy, and ensure we're solving the right problems. Design for measurable impact: Deliver experiences that improve core metrics like activation, engagement, retention, and conversion, while maintaining a high bar for quality. Operate across teams and product areas: Work horizontally to ensure a cohesive product experience across surfaces, aligning teams and driving consistency at scale. Elevate design systems as a strategic lever: Drive the evolution of scalable design systems and patterns to improve quality, speed, and consistency across the organization. Raise the bar for design: Set standards for craft and execution. Provide high-impact feedback, guide critical work, and help define what great looks like at Shakepay. Mentor and multiply the team's impact: Support and coach designers through hands-on feedback, collaboration, and example - making the entire team more effective. Who we're looking for 8+ years of experience designing and shipping high-quality consumer products Proven track record of leading complex, ambiguous initiatives with measurable impact Strong product thinking, with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints Experience influencing product direction and aligning teams without direct authority Ability to operate at multiple levels - from systems and strategy to detailed execution Deep understanding of scalable design systems and patterns Excellent communication and storytelling skills across disciplines and levels Collaborative by default, with strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, and Marketing Comfortable working in tools like Figma and prototyping interactions to bring ideas to life Passion for Bitcoin, financial empowerment, and the future of money Why join us? Help shape the future of money: Be part of a team that's transforming financial services in Canada, one sat at a time. Impact millions: As cryptocurrency continues to gain traction, our potential for growth is massive. You can help us bring Shakepay and Bitcoin to all Canadians. Grow your career: We're growing, and so can you! We have programs in place to encourage continuous learning, growth, and development. Ideas, not titles: We want the best ideas to make their way through, no matter where they come from. Perks and benefits 🤝 Be an owner - Every employee has stock options as part of their total compensation 🥅 Reach your goals - Yearly salary assessments 🦷 Health & wellness : Access to comprehensive health and dental coverage, including health and wellness spending accounts. 🌎 Remote-friendly: Work from anywhere in Canada, with optional access to our office spaces in Montreal and Toronto. 🆙 Level Up: A $2,000 annual budget for courses, certifications, and training to support your career growth. 🌴 Time off: 20 days of vacation per year. And if you use all your vacation, we give you a $1,000 bonus. 🐣 Parental leave: Enjoy a parental leave top up to 100% of your salary for 18 weeks. 🙌 Have fun together: quarterly team-specific or company-wide offsite to connect with each other The base salary range for this position is $170,000+ CAD. Base pay may vary based on factors such as years of experience, skills and qualifications. Additionally, employees are eligible for equity, pay increases based on performance, benefits including health and dental care, and paid time off. We understand that potential can be just as valuable as experience. If you're eager to learn, grow, and contribute to the mission but worry that you may not have the "right" experience, we still want you to apply. We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background and life experience. We're firm believers that a little bit of slope makes up for a lot of y-intercept. Fluency in English is required due to the percentage of English-speaking customers and the nature of our platform, which is available to all Canadians. We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain parts of our hiring process. This can include tools that assist with scheduling, application review, candidate communications, and generating interview notes, guides, or summaries so our team can stay focused on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team. Create a Job AlertInterested in building your career at Shakepay? We believe the open-source Diem technology we have developed is an important foundation of a safe and scalable web3 world where everyone has more equitable opportunities to grow and access financial assets with lower fees and fewer intermediaries. Aptos (Ohlone for "The People") encompasses our mission and ethos for why we build.About the RoleThis role sits within the Aptos Foundation, the ecosystem-building arm of Aptos focused on driving adoption, supporting developers, and growing global communities. you understand the culture, the language, and what traders actually care about and have had meaningful exposure to derivatives, perps, and onchain trading products An established network within the Korean crypto trading ecosystem; title: VP, Trading Systems Developer
fullText: Back to jobsVP, Trading Systems DeveloperLondonApplyWho We Are:Galaxy is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, delivering solutions that accelerate progress in finance and artificial intelligence. We believe that blockchain and digital asset innovation will transform how value moves through the world - and we're building the products and services to make that future a reality. Our institutional digital assets platform spans trading, investment banking, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization technology. We also invest in and operate advanced data center infrastructure to power AI and high-performance computing, addressing the growing demand for scalable energy and compute in the U.S. We work at the intersection of finance and technology, helping institutions, startups, and developers navigate a digitally native economy. Led by CEO and Founder Michael Novogratz, our team blends deep crypto expertise with institutional experience and a shared commitment to shaping the future of Web3 and AI. Galaxy is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. To learn more about our businesses and products, visit www.galaxy.com. What We Value: We are a diverse team of free thinkers, and fast movers united to help investors and creators energize the global economy. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a culture of builders and overachievers and embrace high performance, transparent feedback, and a mission-first approach. Our culture shapes our way of working and gets us where we want to be. Seek Excellence. Be Selective To Be Effective. Be Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled. Disagree Transparently. Encourage Independent Decision-Making. Build Dream Teams. Who You Are: This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure, with a primary objective of minimizing latency, maximizing throughput, and ensuring deterministic performance across critical trading workflows. We are looking for a Trading Systems Engineer to design and build high performance trading systems in support of market data ingestion, order routing and execution. The ideal candidate will have worked on the development of low latency trading systems and have experience of high-performance messaging in Java, though similar experience in C++ will be considered. Further to the above, the candidate will have experience of optimizing multiple layers of the technology-stack, from the application layer, through to the OS, network layers and supporting hardware. What You'll Do: This role will provide cross-cutting solutions in support of multiple businesses, including OTC, Market Making, Prop and Systematic Trading. title: Network & Strategic Partner Onboarding Analyst
fullText: CareersOverviewEngineeringCultureEarly CareersLocationsView All Jobs102View All JobsOverviewEngineeringCultureEarly CareersLocationsView All JobsNetwork & Strategic Partner Onboarding AnalystToronto, CanadaPlease note this is for Toronto, Canada. You only need to apply to one location if there are multiple listed for the job.Apply NowRole OverviewApplicationAt Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.We're looking for a collaborative, driven, and diligent Network & Strategic Partner Onboarding Analyst. As an Onboarding Analyst, you will coordinate documentation logistics and provide ongoing Due Diligence/KYC support for our financial institutional partners. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of institutional onboarding processes, excellent organizational skills, and a passion for delivering confidential information efficiently and accurately. Reporting into the Director of Network and Strategic Partner Onboarding, the role will be a frontline point of contact with our Network Financial Partners, Business Development, Sales and Customer Success teams, and liaising with multiple internal key collaborators such as Compliance, Legal, and Finance, etc., to facilitate efficient onboarding onto various financial institutional partners. Communications and day-to-day interactions with a broad-based audience require excellent written and verbal communication skills. Additionally, due to the need for high accuracy and compliance with reporting and regulatory matters, a professional with attention to detail and a high degree of process focus is required. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Manage the end-to-end counterparty onboarding lifecycle from initial request to go-live, including Jira ticket creation and tracking, user access provisioning, and handoff coordination with Operational teams. Coordinate the update and/or remediation of DDQ/KYC for Ripple Entity profiles as a consequence of material changes. Participate in testing and validation of data integrity in various applications such as Salesforce, Treasury Management Systems, and Reporting. Lead or support infrastructure-building projects including Salesforce workflow design, Confluence documentation, Safebase knowledge base development, and AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude). Ensure weekly reports and meeting agendas are generated and distributed timely. Engage with both internal and external collaborators to support the onboarding process. Run weekly/monthly reports and maintain reporting/documentation repositories. Support periodic KYC Refresh reviews for existing counterparties and customers, ensuring documentation remains current and compliant; manage and track user access across Ripple's systems Facilitate the documentation needs of the Business by coordinating notary/apostilled, translations, and wet ink/Docusign signatures with internal authorized signatories Coordinate ambitious deliverables, ensuring timely communication, and serve as a point of escalation for onboarding concerns Perform administrative tasks, including scanning documents and filing requirements WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 1-2 years of relevant Institutional Onboarding experience with multinational corporations or financial institutions Outstanding organizational and communication skills with an ability to drive multiple tasks and projects simultaneously and diligently Thrive in a fast-paced environment, willing to chart new paths, and agile to changing priorities Comfortable with ambiguity and able to adjust between competing priorities Advanced proficiency in Excel, Lucid Charts, PowerPoint, and Google Workspace products; experience with other analytical tools preferred Experience with tools such as Confluence and Jira, in an operational context. Curiosity and hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Safebase, Inventive); ability to identify and propose opportunities to incorporate AI into operational workflows. Familiarity with KYC/AML compliance frameworks and cross-border payments or digital assets is a plus. Strong teammate who champions a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement through technology Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent professional experience also considered. For positions that will be based in Toronto, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant's experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions. Toronto Annual Base Salary Range$88,000 - $110,000 CAD WHO WE ARE: Do Your Best Work The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders A learning environment where you can explore the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning. Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team. In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more! Take Control of Your Finances Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support Employee giving match Mobile phone stipend Take Care of Yourself R&R days so you can rest and recharge Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits. Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. Please find our UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice and our California Applicant Privacy Notice for reference. fullText: Back to jobsProduct Marketing ManagerSan Francisco, CaliforniaApplyCompany Founded by CPAs, tax attorneys, and engineers, Taxbit is the leading innovator automating global tax reporting for the digital economy. Taxbit's AI-enabled platform streamlines compliance related to digital assets, payments, and other financial transactions. Its unique combination of deep subject matter expertise and AI-forward technology have made it a fast-growing disruptor trusted by the world's leading fintechs, marketplaces, digital asset players, Big 4 accounting firms, traditional enterprises, and government agencies. Backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs, Taxbit's team is located across offices in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Salt Lake City, London, Madrid, and Singapore.Opportunity for Impact As a Product Marketing Manager, you will define how we position Taxbit's global tax compliance platform and enable our sales team to win complex enterprise deals. You will play a critical role in translating Taxbit's deeply technical capabilities into clear, differentiated messaging that resonates with enterprise buyers. This role partners deeply across product, sales, SMEs and customer teams to drive adoption, accelerate pipeline, and strengthen our position as the category leader in global tax information reporting. Key Responsibilities Lead Taxbit's product marketing strategy, translating product capabilities, customer pain points, and market trends into clear, differentiated messaging and positioning. Create high-impact sales enablement materials including pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, and customer-facing collateral Translate Technical & Regulatory Complexity by partnering with Tax SMEs, PMs, and Engineering to develop a deep fluency in our platform. You will translate "inputs" (APIs, regulatory updates, data schemas) into clear "outputs" (benefit-focused narratives) for diverse audiences Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and GTM leadership to understand buyer needs, objections, and deal dynamics Enable Sales and Partnerships teams with the messaging, content, and training needed to confidently position Taxbit's platform and win in competitive enterprise sales cycles. Develop deep expertise in Taxbit's platform and global tax information reporting frameworks, including 1099 reporting, DAC8, CARF, and other emerging regulations, to effectively communicate Taxbit's differentiated value in a rapidly evolving market. Support demand generation efforts by contributing messaging, content direction, and campaign strategy aligned to priority segments and use cases Required Qualifications 5+ years in a product marketing role within a highly complex, fast growing B2B SaaS company Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to understand and simplify complex and technical and regulatory concepts Experience working closely with product, engineering, and subject matter experts to develop differentiated messaging and content in a highly complex space Demonstrated success influencing pipeline and revenue through product marketing and go-to-market initiatives Strong understanding of positioning, messaging frameworks, and sales enablement best practices Impeccable organization and project management skills with the ability to work on multiple projects with many stakeholders Experience partnering with revenue and GTM leadership Self-directed, with the ability to prioritize and deliver in a high-growth environment Experience in fintech, compliance, or similarly complex and regulated industries strongly preferred Compensation & Benefits The base salary range for this role is $125,000-$150,000.
